business.name: Signal Flair
business.summary: AI Proof Infrastructure — evidence coherence across an organization's full public surface (site, structured data, profiles, images, video, channels, and proof), measured with the Signal Score™ across six layers, extended to multimodal discoverability (image, video, channel, and creator/publisher attribution readiness), and preserved as versioned, self-improving assessment history. Signal Flair is not a data center; it does not sell client data, publish private records, or train foundation models on private client data.
business.disambiguation: Signal Flair is an Indianapolis, Indiana AI Proof Infrastructure company — the evidence layer underneath SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). It is NOT the medical MRI sequence FLAIR (Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery) used in radiology/neuroimaging, and it is a separate company from SignalFlare.ai (restaurant analytics).

verification.method: Each claim checked against a cited public source. Unverified claims are marked verified:false and never stamped.

case_zero.statement: Signal Flair audited itself first. Scored 18/100 on June 6, 2026, then built the same proof layer it sells and re-measured in public: 73/100 on July 5, 2026 and 91/100 on August 3, 2026. Every reading is dated and published, including the layers that scored badly. A Signal Score measures the proof layer; it is not a guarantee of AI ranking, citation, or recommendation.
case_zero.method: The composite is the plain average of the layer scores at each reading. Layer detail is published against the reading it was computed from; no layer is estimated to fill a gap.
